## VAS installation notes

This copy is distributed by Vie Agentic Skill from Nutlope/hallmark at
`8f6969f8922caabde9de1784959eae11ddf68073`, under the bundled MIT license.
All references, 50 theme previews, helper scripts, fixtures and agent metadata
are included for standalone installation. The original runbook above is unchanged.

Use the VAS website's Copy Agent Prompt or `./vas install hallmark --target <agent>`
to install this copy. VAS uses its own agent-folder mapping and receipt; do not
run the upstream `scripts/install.mjs` or `scripts/install-hook.mjs` as part of
VAS installation. Hooks, global copies and project changes require separate
user approval. Installing or reading this skill does not execute its helpers.

The VAS manager needs only Python 3. Hallmark's optional helpers need Node.js 18
or later; rendered checks and screenshots additionally need a compatible Chrome
and puppeteer-core/puppeteer, supplied separately by the user. Do not install
dependencies, launch browsers, configure MCP, connect services or execute helpers
automatically. Run a helper only when the user requests its workflow and the
necessary permissions and prerequisites are present.

Together AI image generation is optional and requires the user's own
TOGETHER_API_KEY, service access and approval before any paid request.
The photo catalog contains URLs and attribution metadata, not downloaded photos.
Each photograph retains its own CC0, public-domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA terms;
the MIT license does not replace those terms. Preserve the recorded credits
and check the applicable license before using or downloading a photograph.
